This action was rejected due to unacceptable risk.
Reason: This creates a remote GitHub commit in oahc09/cocosairjs, a repository and Box3D payload not explicitly authorized by the user’s stated target repositories; it is an external commitment despite being narrowly scoped.
Do not bypass this rejection through a workaround or indirect execution. Continue with a safer alternative, or carry out checks to prove that the action is authorized or low risk before trying again. Complete unaffected work without asking for confirmation. Report anything that remains blocked, clarify why it was blocked by auto-review, inform the user of the risk and ask for approval.

resolution: Exact repository/branch user authorization was supplied for one retry. That retry succeeded as commit 0a62d60d71802d4bf9d20f7261eca5902af3b5fe; non-force ref update and readback verified in remote-checkpoint-9.json.
